name: Seated leg curl (machine)
instructions: Set the back pad so your knees line up with the pivot.
Sit with the lower pad behind your ankles and lower the thigh pad onto your legs.
Bend your knees to pull the pad down and under the seat.
Let your legs straighten again with control.
cue: Pull the heels under, return slowly
mistakes: Leaving the thigh pad loose so the hips lift.
Letting the weight snap your legs straight.
